# Ayamullah Khan | Full-Stack & AI Engineer

> Full-stack and AI engineer based in Delhi, India. Three years shipping production systems end to end in Go, TypeScript and Python, from data model and API design through deployment and monitoring. Founding engineer and software consultant at oorik Technologies. Open to engineering roles.

This file helps AI agents and LLMs understand and navigate this portfolio. The website is a single-page app rendered client-side, so the complete text content is mirrored in plain markdown at /llms-full.txt.

## How to navigate this site
The site is one page (https://ayamk.in) with anchored sections:
- `#about` - bio, skills, education, certifications
- `#capabilities` - engineering focus areas
- `#experience` - work history (oorik Technologies, myAIcademy, Peach, HYRGPT, SQU, CSIR-IHBT)
- `#work` - selected projects, with live demos and source links
- `#contact` - availability, contact details, and a message form

## Focus areas
- **Backend and APIs** - Go, Hono, FastAPI, OpenAPI-first design, webhooks and idempotency, background workers
- **Agentic and LLM systems** - agent orchestration, RAG, embeddings and re-ranking, LLM evals, voice AI
- **Data and multi-tenancy** - PostgreSQL, Drizzle, row-level security, incremental migrations, MongoDB, Firestore
- **Full-stack product** - React, Next.js, Flutter, Razorpay and Pine Labs integrations
- **Cloud and reliability** - GCP Cloud Run, AWS, Docker, Railway, Vercel, GitHub Actions, Sentry

## Selected work
- [oorik ERP](https://erp.oorik.in) - multi-tenant SaaS ERP for Indian SMBs
- [fya](https://github.com/ayam04/fya) - open-source security scanner, 58 checks, 800+ downloads, 42 GitHub stars
- [tech-doc-ocr](https://github.com/ayam04/tech-doc-ocr) - document delta and grounded chat over drawing revisions
- [Deal Dossier Generator](https://dossier.ayamk.in) - Gemini with Google Search grounding
- [LeetLingo](https://leetlingo.site/) - AI interview-prep platform
- [Multi-Agent RAG Customer Support](https://github.com/ayam04/multi-rag-customer-support) - MongoDB + FAISS + OpenAI
